newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close higher as oil stocks, dollar gain.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close higher as oil stocks, dollar gain.

text.p: UK stocks snapped two days of declines to close higher on Monday, propelled by gains in oil stocks and underpinned by strength in the dollar and firm gilts.

The FTSE 100 closed up 16.8 points 3,884.4, near the day's best, with gaining stocks outweighing decliners by some two-to-one. After dropping sharply in the previous two sessions, the index ended just 43 points below its record set August 28.

Shell and BP were among the biggest gainers as Iraq tensions lifted oil prices and boosted the dollar, helping lift dollar earners like BTR and Zeneca. Yet volume remained low, at just 390.5 million by 1544 GMT, with Wall St closed for Labor Day.
